strategy.pyramid: Start lighter and build intensity set by set. Check condition as loads rise — quality over ego.
strategy.dropSet: After a hard set, drop weight and keep reps going. Stop before form collapses.
strategy.superSet: Link two moves with short rests. Extend rest if breathing gets ragged.
strategy.prChallenge: Warm up fully, then consider a harder attempt only on the last set.
strategy.volumeUp: Add a little volume via sets/reps rather than a big jump in load.
strategy.weightHold: Hold load steady and prioritize form and range.
strategy.slowControl: Move slowly through a full range and feel the stimulus.
strategy.highWeight: Warm up well, then use lower reps. Reckless max attempts aren't recommended.
strategy.default: Today’s strategy is {{strategy}}. Pick one goal — stimulus, quality, or volume — and execute.

yinYang.yang: Yang energy is relatively strong today — lean into action and execution.
yinYang.yin: Yin energy is relatively strong today — lean into focus, recovery, and tidy-up.

GROWTH_EXPAND.lead: Today’s core energy is growth and expansion.
GROWTH_EXPAND.body: Your base energy and today’s flow support widening your attempts. In training, expand stimulus one step.

FOCUS_BREAKTHROUGH.lead: Today’s core energy is focus and breakthrough.
FOCUS_BREAKTHROUGH.body: Channel effort into one clear target. Train with precise execution and a deliberate challenge set.

RECOVERY_RESET.lead: Today’s core energy is recovery and reset.
RECOVERY_RESET.body: Favor pacing over forceful expansion. Lower intensity and prioritize quality, breathing, and recovery.

CHANGE_STIMULUS.lead: Today’s core energy is change and new stimulus.
CHANGE_STIMULUS.body: A small twist to a familiar routine fits well. Change equipment, angle, or structure lightly.

STABILITY_BALANCE.lead: Today’s core energy is stability and balance.
STABILITY_BALANCE.body: Keep overall balance rather than pushing one extreme. Train evenly without big jumps.

ACCUMULATE_STEADY.lead: Today’s core energy is steady accumulation.
ACCUMULATE_STEADY.body: A day for stacking, not finishing in one shot. Build volume with quality reps.

EXECUTE_PUSH.lead: Today’s core energy is execution and push.
EXECUTE_PUSH.body: Momentum favors acting now. Run your planned session with density.

ORGANIZE_TRANSITION.lead: Today’s core energy is organize and transition.
ORGANIZE_TRANSITION.body: Good for closing a chapter and preparing the next. Tidy the routine and set up the next stimulus.

pillars.what: The four pillars (year/month/day/hour) are the basic structure used to sketch a person’s chart. Each pillar pairs a stem (outward quality of energy) with a branch (the setting/flow it sits in).
pillars.look: They lightly reference roots, environment, self, and possibility, and separate “what kind of force shows up” from “what environment it moves through” — background for reading today’s story, not a professional verdict.
pillars.gym: Think of the four pillars as the broader picture of the training personality and setting you’re standing on. Stem ≈ the style of force in today’s session; branch ≈ the flow/setting that force moves in.
pillars.yearGym: The background where your training story began
pillars.hourGym: Hints about how you might grow next
